heading: OCR engine × layout model comparison in docling-serve
method: Setup: every configuration runs in the test image built by run_engines.sh from Dockerfile.engines: our published image ghcr.io/dcc-bs/dcc-docling-serve-cu130:v1.38.1 (docling-serve v1.38.1, docling-glm-ocr 0.5.2, docling-pp-doc-layout 0.2.6) plus the Egret layout weights. The Nemotron OCR configurations run in a second image that adds Nemotron OCR v2 2.0.2 and torch 2.11, which it is built against; that torch makes the rest of the pipeline (layout, table structure) slower, so their times are not directly comparable. One GPU, the same options for all (table_mode accurate, ocr_lang de, pdf_backend docling_parse, markdown with image placeholders, a page-break placeholder to split pages); only the OCR engine and the layout model change. RapidOCR runs on onnxruntime GPU with the shape patch active. GLM-OCR is zai-org/GLM-OCR served by vLLM 0.30 and called per region. Nemotron OCR v2 gets ocr_lang iso:de, which docling routes to its English recognizer: NVIDIA validates no other Latin-script language.

Full-page VLM configurations: Nemotron 3.5 Parse (vLLM 0.26 with NVIDIA's plugin, FlashAttention 3 flag left out on non-Hopper GPUs) and LightOnOCR-3-4B (vLLM 0.31) replace layout, OCR and table structure with one model that reads the whole page, through docling's VLM pipeline and the presets in vlm_presets.json. Their layout column reads VLM (full page).

Plugin versions: the published image has docling-pp-doc-layout 0.2.5 (raw layout clusters, so scanned pages get OCR'd; confidence threshold 0.3 by default) and docling-glm-ocr 0.5.2 (full-page fallback only on pages without PDF text, repetition-loop guard, output cap per crop, HTML tables and code fences cleaned up). The Previous vs published tab compares it with the earlier local runs: docling-glm-ocr 0.5.1 with docling-pp-doc-layout 0.2.4 at threshold 0.3.

Timing: server-side conversion time reported by docling-serve (processing_time), models already loaded; wall time (upload to result download) where the server did not report it. For GLM-OCR this includes the calls to the vLLM server.

Synthetic documents: generated with exact ground truth. Body F1 compares the words of the output with the ground-truth markdown; Headings, Tables, Order and Noise as in the converter comparison. The text-source table tags every snippet by how it is stored in the PDF (real text, vector outlines, embedded image, scan).
Real documents: compared with the PDF's own text layer (pypdfium2) on pages that have one. Recall below 1 means missing text, precision below 1 means extra words (OCR of images, noise, duplicates).
Reference transcriptions: the handwritten note (ocr.png) and the phone photo (PXL_…jpg) have no text layer; they are scored against hand-made transcriptions in references.json.

Empty pages: a page has text when its text layer has at least 20 words or when any configuration read at least 20 words from it (scans, photos). It counts as empty for a configuration that returned fewer than 5 words for it. The released plugin leaves empty pages out of the markdown altogether, so its page split is shorter than the document; those outputs are aligned to the pages by word overlap with the text layer and the other configurations.

Words not in the reference: output words that appear nowhere in the ground truth (synthetic documents) or the reference transcription. Words with a close match in the reference (similarity ≥ 0.7) are likely misreadings; the others are text the engine made up or read from elsewhere on the page.
title: OCR Engine × Layout Comparison
